title: The ooRexx Object Editor (same lane, folder object-editor/)
summary: The Object Editor (v0.3, folder object-editor/ of branch oodialog-designer in animatedads/oorexx; architecture Tom Dyer, code Claude (Opus 5.5)) edits a class file found by reflection, not by scanning text: the file is loaded with .Package~new(name, lines) (prolog blanked), and classes, hierarchy, mixins, members, visibility, guard, abstract and what ::requires bring in are read back from the objects. Edits change directive segments (OxSource) and reload at once; one that does not compile is undone and refused with ooRexx's message. Completion asks the objects. It shares with the designer: OodNls/OodUi texts, the Libraries panel (LibraryProviders.cls), the plugins (Boston Crab, Ask…, Repository…), the Database Lab, and the Rexx Parser for OxDocs. Build: rexx tools/build.rex RUNTIME_DIR OODIALOG_WASM_DIST DESIGNER_SITE/examples (the designer's site must be built first). Tests: tests/t01_object.rex (57 checks, run in examples/ with the parser's parent on REXX_PATH), tests/t02_libraries.rex, tools/oxtest.py (11 scenarios; OOD_DESIGNER names the designer folder).
invariants: Discovery is by reflection; never replace it with a text scanner (inherited members, mixin order and a library's methods need the objects).
Every edit compiles or is undone.
It has no Autobuild package of its own yet: it lives on the branch beside the designer.
